derivation: The inner fan-out has already expanded under the first outer object, retaining pass 1 for the pair of that construct and that outer enclosing prefix. COMP-002 keys the counter on exactly that pair: pass numbers are one plus the largest retained pass for the pair, or one on first entry in that context. This expansion is under the second outer object, a different exact outer prefix, so it is a first entry in its own context and allocates pass 1 rather than pass 2. LIFE-018 and FAN-001 state the same rule from the other side and make clear this is not the excluded repeat-expansion case, which is re-entry under the same outer prefix. The supplied set is at the per-expansion object maximum, which is the largest admissible set rather than a refusal; the separate instance-wide occurrence and active-obligation limits still apply and are not crossed. FAN-001 fixes the resulting rows: the pass retains the source-ordered object key list, occurrence ordinals follow that order, each object occurrence carries the fan-out pass identity, object key and complete enclosing ancestry including the outer object key, and because the expand occurrence is directly owned by an outer obligation that obligation moves to WAITING on the exact child-pass reference in the same transition.
